items.quote:
The total number of family leaders over the fighting men was 2,600.
13  Under their command was an army of 307,500 men trained for war
items.contrast: The 307,500 men were under the 2,600 family leaders, not directly under Uzziah.
items.reason: The reader must resolve “their” to the family leaders named immediately before it. The passage explicitly states both their number and their command over the army.
